statements.attributed: reported the phenomenon of face-centered-cubic (fcc) type Ru nanoparticles (NPs) obtained by chemical reduction
statements.quote: This phenomenon was reported in 2013 for face-centered-cubic (fcc) type Ru nanoparticles (NPs) obtained by chemical reduction.

statements.attributed: analyzed the dependence of properties of the fcc Ru on lattice parameters by ab initio calculations
statements.quote: However, the dependence of properties of the fcc Ru on lattice parameters was analyzed by ab initio calculations, although naturally occurring bulk Ru forms only a hexagonal close-packed (hcp) structure.

statements.attributed: controlled the structure and crystal size by adjusting the composition of mixtures of the Ru precursor and reducing agent
statements.quote: The structure and crystal size are controlled by adjusting the composition of mixtures of the Ru precursor and reducing agent.

statements.attributed: found that the catalytic activity of Ru NPs is dependent on the fcc and hcp structure and size
statements.quote: Moreover, the catalytic activity of Ru NPs, supported on γ-Al2O3 for CO oxidation, is dependent on the fcc and hcp structure and size.

statements.attributed: found that for NPs larger than 3 nm, the newly obtained fcc Ru NPs are more reactive than conventional hcp Ru NPs
statements.quote: For NPs larger than 3 nm, the newly obtained fcc Ru NPs are more reactive than conventional hcp Ru NPs.

statements.attributed: found that the catalytic activity of the fcc Ru NPs increases with increasing particle size, despite the decrease in surface area
statements.quote: Counterintuitively, the catalytic activity of the fcc Ru NPs increases with increasing particle size, despite the decrease in surface area.

statements.attributed: used laboratory-based X-ray instruments to determine phase identification and crystalline domain size
statements.quote: Phase identification and crystalline domain size have been determined from the peak widths obtained by X-ray diffraction (XRD), by using laboratory-based X-ray instruments.

statements.attributed: revealed atomic-scale three-dimensional configurations in hcp Ru NPs
statements.quote: Another study has revealed atomic-scale three-dimensional configurations in hcp Ru NPs, by using a high-energy X-ray source (90.48 keV), reverse Monte Carlo simulations, and atomic pair distribution function analyses.

statements.attributed: fabricated the fcc and hcp Ru NPs by chemical reduction methods
statements.quote: The fcc and hcp Ru NPs were fabricated by chemical reduction methods using Ru(acac)3 and RuCl3 · nH2O, respectively, as the metal precursors, and poly(N-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone) (PVP) as the stabilizing agent; the detailed procedure has been described in ref. .

statements.attributed: determined the size and temperature for 50% conversion of CO to CO2
statements.quote: The details for the determination of size and temperature for 50% conversion of CO to CO2 (T50) are also described in ref. .

statements.attributed: used the Rietveld refinement method for a pseudo-Voigt function
statements.quote: All XRD patterns for the Ru NPs were analyzed using the Rietveld refinement method for a pseudo-Voigt function.

statements.attributed: found that the phase identification of all the Ru NPs was in agreement with that obtained from high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images
statements.quote: The phase identification of all the Ru NPs, determined from Rietveld analysis, was in agreement with that obtained from high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images given in ref. .

statements.attributed: found that the theoretical value of fcc Ru bulk is a = 3.83 Å
statements.quote: Notably, the lattice parameter of fcc Ru NPs was larger than the theoretical value of fcc Ru bulk (a = 3.83 Å) and tended to increase with decreasing particle size.

statements.attributed: found that the lattice parameters of hcp bulk Ru are a = 2.7058(2) Å and c = 4.2816(7) Å
statements.quote: In contrast, the lattice parameters of hcp Ru NPs were smaller than those for hcp bulk Ru (a = 2.7058(2) Å, c = 4.2816(7) Å), and tended to contract with decreasing particle size, except for sample 6.

statements.attributed: reported the mechanism of CO oxidation with hcp Ru
statements.quote: The mechanism of CO oxidation with hcp Ru has been reported to begin with the oxidation of Ru (001), thus forming several RuO2 (1110) layers, after which CO oxidation occurs on RuO2 (110).
